name: ChauffeurPilot Booking
author: tahiramjad

sections.description:
ChauffeurPilot Booking connects your WordPress site to a ChauffeurPilot organization and renders the hosted booking experience your customers use on the embed network.

This plugin does not process payments inside WordPress. Checkout, card data, and Stripe Connect onboarding stay in the ChauffeurPilot operator dashboard.

Connected external service (required disclosure)

When a page loads a booking mount, the plugin:

  • Enqueues a local copy of embed.js from the plugin assets (not a remote CDN).
  • Opens an iframe on the ChauffeurPilot embed host (embed.chauffeurpilot.com in Live, or embed-staging.chauffeurpilot.com in Test).
  • Passes your organization slug and environment (test or live) so the correct published form loads.

Visitor journey data may be passed in the parent page URL for lite to full handoff; the full form forwards allowed query keys into the iframe. Booking and payment data are handled on ChauffeurPilot infrastructure, not stored by this plugin beyond site settings (org slug, environment, default full-form URL).

Documentation: help.chauffeurpilot.com/operators/wordpress/

Features

  • Gutenberg block – ChauffeurPilot Booking with mode, placement, and handoff controls.
  • Shortcode – preferred [chaubo_booking]; legacy alias [chauffeurpilot_booking] still works with the same attributes.
  • Elementor widget – optional; same renderer as the block.
  • Lite and full modes – homepage lite search with handoff to a /book page on your site.
  • Test vs Live – staging embed for local/dev hosts; production embed when Live is selected on a public site.
  • Modal placement – optional button that opens the form in a dialog.

Support

Support for the ChauffeurPilot platform is available to customers via ChauffeurPilot. This plugin is maintained for embedding on self-hosted WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or install from the WordPress.org directory when published.
  2. Activate ChauffeurPilot Booking.
  3. Open Settings → ChauffeurPilot and enter your organization slug from Connect organization.
  4. Set Default full form page URL if you use lite or auto mode (recommended).
  5. Add the block, shortcode [chaubo_booking], or Elementor widget to a page.
  6. Complete Stripe Connect and pricing in the ChauffeurPilot app, not in WordPress.

See the installation guide for screenshots and checklists.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store card numbers or run Stripe in WordPress?

No. Payments run inside the ChauffeurPilot iframe on the embed host. Connect Stripe in the ChauffeurPilot dashboard.

What external scripts does the plugin load?

The plugin vendors embed.js locally under assets/js/embed.js and enqueues it from your WordPress site. That script opens an iframe from:

  • Live: https://embed.chauffeurpilot.com
  • Test: https://embed-staging.chauffeurpilot.com

Allow those embed hosts in CSP and security plugins if you restrict iframes or third-party frames.

What is Test vs Live?

Test uses the staging embed (safe for staging sites and required on localhost, private IPs, and local / development WordPress environments).

Live uses the production embed on public hosts after you verify your site under Connect → Channels → Embed sites.

Do I need Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional for the ChauffeurPilot Booking widget. The Gutenberg block and shortcode work without it.

Why is Live disabled on my computer?

Local and development hosts cannot point at the production embed. The plugin forces Test mode automatically.

How does lite to full booking work?

Place a lite mount on your homepage with full_form_url pointing to a WordPress page that has a full mount. Journey fields are appended to the parent URL and forwarded into the full iframe.

Which shortcode should I use?

Prefer [chaubo_booking]. The legacy alias [chauffeurpilot_booking] remains registered for existing content.

Where is my data processed?

See Privacy & data on the help site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Package slug alignment: distributable folder and main file are chauffeurpilot/chauffeurpilot.php.
  • Settings UI documents preferred shortcode [chaubo_booking] and legacy alias [chauffeurpilot_booking].
  • CSS custom properties renamed from --cp-* to --chaubo-*.
  • One-time migration copies legacy cp_booking_options into chaubo_options when the new option is empty.
  • Copy cleanup for WordPress.org review (no em dashes in strings or docs).

1.0.4

  • WordPress.org review: unique chaubo_ / CHAUBO_ prefixes for classes, functions, options, handles, and hooks.
  • Text domain set to plugin slug chauffeurpilot.
  • Contributors list uses WordPress.org username tahiramjad.
  • Preferred shortcode [chaubo_booking] (legacy [chauffeurpilot_booking] still works).

1.0.1

  • Professional settings Setup status: parent origin copy, effective iframe host, Test/Live badge, Connect deep links.
  • Gutenberg and Elementor: Mode & handoff, Placement & height, Advanced panels with clearer guidance.
  • Docs aligned: local embed.js loader + iframe on ChauffeurPilot hosts (not CDN script).

1.0.0

  • Initial public release: Gutenberg block, shortcode, Elementor widget, Test/Live environments, lite/full handoff, modal placement.
